description: This file defines a custom JSP tag class ContentImageUrlTag used to generate URLs for content images within the shopizer e-commerce platform. It constructs image URLs dynamically based on store configuration, request context, and tag attributes.

classes.name: ContentImageUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that generates image URLs based on store configuration and request parameters.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates and outputs the complete URL for a content image based on merchant store data and request context.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Returns evaluation for end of tag processing.
